session.title: Set the tone
session.tip: Meet somewhere private, have the call examples ready, and explain the purpose in one sentence.
say: Thanks for making time. I'd like to go through a couple of calls with you, hear your view, and agree on one or two things to focus on.
This is a conversation, so jump in any time.

session.title: Start with what went well
session.tip: Be specific and use only what you actually observed. If nothing was marked as observed, move to the next step.

session.title: Ask before you tell
session.tip: Let the agent assess the call first. Listen more than you talk, and build on what they notice.
say: Before I share what I noticed, how do you think that call went?

session.title: Share what you observed
session.tip: Describe the behavior and its impact on the customer, not the person. Pause after each point so the agent can respond.

session.title: Agree on the plan
session.tip: Ask the agent to say the plan back in their own words, and adjust it together if something does not fit.
say: In your own words, what will you do differently on your next call?

session.title: Set the follow-up
session.tip: Name the date of the first review and explain how you will share what you find.

session.title: Close with confidence
session.tip: End on a specific, positive note and thank the agent for the conversation.
say: I'm confident you can do this, and I'll be listening for it. Thank you for being open today.
If anything gets in the way before our check-in, come and find me.

observe.title: Prepared with examples
observe.good: You came prepared with specific call examples, which kept the conversation focused on facts.
observe.gap: Prepare one or two specific call examples before the session so the conversation stays on observed behavior.

observe.title: Opened with a clear purpose
observe.good: You explained the purpose of the session at the start, which helped the agent relax and engage.
observe.gap: Open by explaining the purpose of the session in one sentence, so the agent knows what to expect.

observe.title: Started with a real strength
observe.good: You opened with a specific strength you had observed, which made the agent more open to the feedback that followed.
observe.gap: Start with one specific strength you observed before moving to the opportunity.

observe.title: Asked before telling
observe.good: You asked the agent to assess the call before giving your view, which helped them own the change.
observe.gap: Ask the agent how they think the call went before you share your view.

observe.title: Let the agent talk
observe.good: You listened more than you talked and built on what the agent shared.
observe.gap: Aim for the agent to do at least half of the talking, and use follow-up questions instead of filling the silence.

observe.title: Specific, behavior-based feedback
observe.good: Your feedback described specific behaviors and their impact on the customer rather than the person.
observe.gap: Describe the exact behavior you observed and its impact on the customer, rather than general statements.

observe.title: Measurable action plan
observe.good: Your action plan was specific and measurable, with a clear target and review date.
observe.gap: Make the action plan measurable by naming the behavior, the target, and when it will be reviewed.

observe.title: Agent restated the plan
observe.good: You asked the agent to restate the plan in their own words, which confirmed understanding and agreement.
observe.gap: Before closing, ask the agent to restate the plan in their own words to confirm understanding.

observe.title: Set the follow-up
observe.good: You set a clear follow-up date and explained how you would review the results together.
observe.gap: Set a specific follow-up date and explain how you will review progress before the session ends.

observe.title: Supportive, professional tone
observe.good: Your tone stayed supportive and professional throughout, including when you discussed the opportunity.
observe.gap: Keep a calm, supportive tone throughout, especially while discussing the opportunity.

observe.title: Documented accurately
observe.good: Your coaching notes matched what was discussed and contained no names or identifiers.
observe.gap: Document the session so it matches what was discussed, without names or identifiers.
